run_lstm_trainer: run the LSTM reinforcement learning trainer with a single process runner and loaded environment
create_lstm_trainer: create an LSTMTrainer instance to train an LSTM-based RL agent using rlpytorch
load_environment: load the RL environment and arguments using load_env with a trainer and runner
setup_model_interface: setup a ModelInterface with an LSTM model and configure learning rate and GPU options
register_callbacks: register train and actor callbacks on the game controller for the LSTM trainer
